summary: Ryn defends the caloric budget against extreme thermal shear, handing off a crucial thermal flask to Silas.
science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea
narrative_prose: The Hearth hummed with the ambient frequency of thermodynamic bio-energetics, a low thrum that Ryn felt in her teeth. Before her, the induction stove glowed faintly blue against the heavy brass trim of the galley. A sharp smell of ozone mixed with the earthy tang of myco-proteins as the environmental baffles hissed, fighting the sudden draft from the east corridor. Ryn slammed her heavy brass ladle on the butcher block, calculating the metabolic burn rate of the colony under the shifting barometric pressure. The magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea was already wreaking havoc on their delicate supply lines. 'If you let that threshold drop one more degree, we'll lose three hundred calories per person to ambient shivering alone,' she muttered. She needed to DEFEND the caloric budget with ruthless precision, even as the wild currents outside seemed to ATTRACT the latent static in the air. Grabbing the cast-iron thermal flask from the counter, she moved to CONSUME the remaining heat from the induction coil. She thrust the flask, still vibrating from the ambient charge, directly into Silas's hands, physically handing off the burden. 'Keep it sealed, Silas, unless you want the cold to eat everything we have left.'
